harvestIndicators: R8 — 95% pods at mature pod color
notes: Roundup Ready 2 Xtend trait — tolerant to glyphosate + dicamba. Brand-name commodity soybean. Maturity Group 3.5 fits Mid-Atlantic; adjust by region. Phase 11 trait override: when planted, the kernel allows engenia, xtendimax, and roundup-powermax-3 to be sprayed despite the synthetic-auxin / glyphosate family-kill rule.

sprayWindows.title: PRE residual at planting (Group 15)
sprayWindows.body: Apply a residual soil-applied herbicide such as S-metolachlor as close to planting as possible.

sprayWindows.title: POST fomesafen, three to four weeks after planting
sprayWindows.body: Postemergence spray three to four weeks after planting, when weeds are 4 inches tall or less. Fomesafen (Reflex, Flexstar) goes on postemergence; do not apply it more than once every 2 years.

sprayWindows.title: POST clethodim for grasses, three to four weeks after planting
sprayWindows.body: Postemergence spray three to four weeks after planting, when weeds are 4 inches tall or less. Clethodim (Select Max) goes on postemergence for grass weeds.

sprayWindows.title: POST glyphosate on Roundup Ready soybeans, three to four weeks after planting
sprayWindows.body: Postemergence spray three to four weeks after planting, when weeds are 4 inches tall or less. Glyphosate goes over the top of glyphosate-resistant (Roundup Ready) soybeans only, from emergence through full flowering.
